summary.text: Ashley Drury is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Phil Amato.
Drury is a substitute teacher who, in a Ballotpedia survey, lists well-funded public schools, lower costs and better pay, and government transparency as her campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Ashley Drury graduated from Pattonville High School and earned a graduate degree from Lindenwood University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Drury described herself as a sixth-generation Missourian who has lived in Jefferson County since 2018, a mother of two boys, the spouse of a Navy veteran, and a substitute teacher.

Drury's three key messages in the survey were strong, well-funded public schools; lower costs and better pay, including a living wage; and a government that brings transparency, accountability and ethics back to Jefferson City.
She also said she supports expanding access to mental health care and health care services in underserved and rural areas.
